Lesson 1.1 · Orbital mechanics
Your first orbit

Fly Falcon 9 from Cape Canaveral into a circular orbit 500 km up. Everything is set: press Launch and follow the ascent — the first stage, separation, the second stage cutting off in a 200 × 500 km parking orbit, and its relight at apogee that makes the orbit circular. Once in orbit, work out two numbers for it and type them in: the orbital period and the orbital speed.
